Iterate to central-binomial product for every diagonal. Rational moment recurrence plus physical-level interpolation establishes off-spectrum identity, and parity symmetry removes resonance at odd moment steps so all formal matrix entries equal the actual Gram matrix at every physical E_n. In each interval between lambda_j=j^2-1/4 poles, one diagonal has exactly one negative denominator factor except at the single physical squared numerator zero. Thus for all K>=2, 0<=E<(K-1)^2-1/4, away from poles, PSD iff E_n with n<=K-2. An independent SymPy exact-integration check for j=1..4, n=0..7 agrees; finite tests are only supporting checks, not the all-K proof.
